scope: Bounded proposal06 fixed-local-source semantic review only; no ledger/production/checklist/network/game/git mutations

comparators.input: mana/starting mana, lens full stack, source XYZ/dimension, shooter UUID, motion, collision position list
comparators.output: rebinds source GlobalPos with current dimension fallback when absent/unparseable; restores carried mana/lens and clears/rebuilds collision receipts
comparators.preservation: Full writer, onReceiverImpact and collision methods reviewed: actual receiver receives saved mana and repeated-position membership is queried. Writer explicitly refuses fake simulation bursts. Optional magnetize position defaults null; corrupt list members skipped via codec result. Whole resource carrier counted once.
comparators.application_limit: No root permanent progress inferred from projectile state. HasShooter bool is not typed UUID validation; magnetize codec orThrow may fail, collision tuple guards only X, motion deliberately bypasses native velocity clamp. No runtime projectile simulation claimed.

comparators.input: owner UUID plus client runtime id, DamageThreshold, full ItemStack
comparators.output: server owner resolves durable UUID, client uses runtime ID; physical original stack saved and returned rather than synthesizing default when nonempty
comparators.preservation: Read complete pair, owner resolver, full hurt and spawnBroomItem. Successful inventory add handled before drop fallback; owner stamp reapplied to actual saved item. Distinct rideable owned equipment conversion, not same Borrowed Bewitchment permission-list parser.
comparators.application_limit: Missing/invalid Item becomes EMPTY; fallback manufactures plain haunted broom, losing custom payload. Runtime OwnerClient persisted but not durable server identity. No clear/commit transaction before discard if return drop fails; no old-world native claim. Combat damage itself not persisted, only threshold.

comparators.input: inherited full Trident tool stack, originalSlot, charge/multiplier/water inertia/hitBlock, scheduled task payload
comparators.output: restores original slot or defaults-1; rebinds derived modifier loyalty/foil/noDespawn from saved tool rather than vanilla enchantment only
comparators.preservation: Read full pair, updateFromStack/onRelease and complete return/pickup switch. Returning equipment can restore offhand/armor original slot without overwriting occupied stack; merges only same item+tags else normal inventory add. Actual extension behavior distinct from native thrown-trident generic payload reader. Scheduled task helpers not additional credit.
comparators.application_limit: Stored originalSlot not bounded here, relies inventory getter/setter contract. Missing tasks leaves reused schedule stale; absent charge/multiplier default0 rather than constructor1. Task execution/all modifier persistence not fully traced; no claim all spells preserved. Inherited native owner/Drop policy unchanged.

comparators.input: installed master/creative tier, paid dyed network, invisibility; live adjacency/master references transient
comparators.output: restore tier and base flags without accessing world during deserialize; first server tick rebuilds network; removal returns matching spark tier
comparators.preservation: Read full pair/base class and complete tick/drop/interact/setNetwork consumers. Physical tier survives persistence and determines which actual item returns; runtime graph not copied from stale world. Three tier outcomes one owner, not three alias counts.
comparators.application_limit: Unknown/missing booleans default ordinary spark; network dye decoder default, missing field0. Drop ignores spawn result before discard; returns a fresh tier item so dyed network/invisibility metadata not written to returned item. No guarantee all paid cosmetic state roundtrips.

comparators.input: owned world mana, optional legacy color/cap/policy/keys; temporary animation state separate
comparators.output: preserves ctor canAccept/canSpare true when absent, mana cap -1 resolved from actual block; old white means uncolored; actual transfer uses min(source,destination space)
comparators.preservation: Read full actual resource consumer in both directions and clamps on receive, not mere integer storage. Parent readPacketNBT definitely disk reader as well, verified bridge. Stationary pool distinct prior mobile cart budget owner, no credit for common bridge/legacy color alone.
comparators.application_limit: Reader loads mana raw without cap/clamp; arithmetic current+delta can overflow. Both pool and spreader mistakenly assign outputKey to inputKey, outputKey final empty; current saves may overwrite configured input on reopen. ManaVoid deliberately deletes incoming mana when full. Legacy color application setter internals not deep traced; no full all-recipes claim.

range_hash_convention: Inclusive splitlines joined by LF without trailing newline; candidate method digest additionally outer-strips

proposals.mechanism: Real item creates spark and debits hardware/dye. Interaction installs paid SparkAugmentItem only when NONE, then shrinks input. Own disk pair saves ordinal upgrade; base pair saves dye network/invisibility. Runtime policy uses attached receiver balances: dispersive credits real inventory mana items and debits attached source; recessive/dominant moves finite mana among live receivers. Wand removal returns fresh augment and clears policy/graph; whole removal returns fresh spark plus mapped augment.
proposals.dedup: Accepted173456 already covers physical installed spark tier/network surviving save/load while runtime graph is rebuilt and fresh matching hardware returns. Mana balances remain in external receiver owners (fc968); this spark does not own an additional persistent mana balance. Four augment variants, dye, invisibility and each transfer direction are policy aliases/consumers, not independent new entitlement owners. Therefore owner-clone and wrapper credit0 even though this supplies important implementation contrast.
limits: Unlike previously accepted Corporea deferred graph initialization, this reader calls setUpgrade; base reader also calls virtual setNetwork. Both setters immediately updateTransfers/notifyOthers and query current world. firstTick later repeats initialization. Do not describe this as deserialize-without-world-access or recommend copying it uncritically.
Ordinal indexed directly into SparkUpgradeType.values without range guard; missing upgrade maps NONE, negative/out-of-range throws by Java array semantics. No malformed save runtime executed.
Physical spark/dye debit precedes unchecked addFreshEntity. Removal/refund ignores spawn acknowledgment before discard or policy clear. No atomic delivery guarantee.

Returned spark/augment is newly constructed, so paid dye/invisibility or arbitrary source stack metadata is not retained on refund. Phantom ink sets invisible without observed input shrink in this handler; do not call that path paid consumption.

Transfers own no escrow/receipt. Receiver interfaces mutate current balances; deeper implementation of every receiver/item capability not independently audited. Own policy has no cross-version enum-name migration.

proposals.mechanism: Player use copies actual stack, forces count1, creates projectile, attempts spawn and shrinks source1. Projectile own pair serializes original full fly_stack and flare flag. Bounce/time policy enters return; homing resolves actual getOwner. When owner missing or close enough at return threshold, getItemStack returns saved copy and dropAndKill spawns ItemEntity, then discards. If saved stack empty, fresh flare/thorn fallback is synthesized.
proposals.dedup: Accepted78447 already contains full-stack thrown-tool persistence plus stronger original-slot-aware non-overwriting return and derived rebind; ef2 also has physical saved equipment return with fresh fallback; generic paid resource projectile418 already credited. This owner offers neither distinct migration conversion nor additional permanent entitlement boundary. Bounces/flare/return-ID are not separate credit; omitted phase is negative support, not new owner.
limits: This return spawns a world item, not direct inventory delivery or original-slot restoration. addFreshEntity result ignored on both launch and return; no transaction/acknowledged recovery guarantee.

BOUNCES, RETURN_TO and bounced are not in own save pair; constructors initialize0,-1,false. Own tick uses tickCount>60, but native parent age/owner persistence not audited, so exact reload delay or lifetime reset is not asserted.
RETURN_TO is a synchronized runtime ID/phase flag, while actual homing uses getOwner; do not mistake it for durable owner UUID. Inherited native owner lookup and serialization not expanded.
Reader only assigns fly_stack if key present; reused object can retain prior stack when field absent. Fresh load missing/invalid-empty payload can manufacture plain fallback, losing custom data.

flare separately controls damage effects and fallback; no consistency validation between saved fly_stack item and flare. Hit fire/poison occurs after hurt call without checking returned success. No runtime combat claim.
